documents.name: school-it-help.txt
documents.text:
School IT help sheet

Wi-Fi login. The school Wi-Fi called SCHOOL-STUDENTS asks you to sign in on a web page. If you are connected but no page opens, the sign-in page has not appeared. Open any address that starts with http, not https, for example http://neverssl.com, and the sign-in page should come up. Sign in with the school user name and password.

Wrong date or time. If the clock of the laptop is wrong by more than a few minutes, secure pages fail to open. Set the date and time to update automatically.

Name server problems. If the sign-in works but pages still do not open, the laptop may use a name server of its own from home. In the network settings choose to get the name server automatically.

Proxy. Switch off any proxy that was set for another network. The school network needs none.

Still not working. Write down the name of the network, the time, and what you see, and send them to the IT room.

about.title: Handoff: control moves to the expert, who searches a help sheet
about.author: Agent Atlas Academy
about.description:
The first agent decides it is not the right one and hands the problem to an expert with a note.

**What it teaches**

In a handoff control moves forward and the note is all the next agent knows. The expert reads the help sheet only through a search tool, never whole.

**What to watch**

What is in the note, what the expert searches for, and which passages of the help sheet come back.

Read more: [Handoff](#/learn/handoff)
